top_signals.title: Barclays’ Rajadhayaksha Says Nvidia Market Angst Overdone
top_signals.summary: Barlcays' Global Research Chairman Ajay Rajadhyaksha says markets are overplaying jitters over a Nvidia leadership change and will back risk assets. "Things are not as bad as the markets suggest." He speaks to Bloomberg's Anna Edwards and Guy Johnson on Bloomberg's "The Opening Trade." (Source: Bloomberg)
